about: Oil-Dri Corporation of America, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and markets sorbent products in the United States and internationally. It operates in two segments: Retail and Wholesale Products Group, and Business to Business Products Group. The company provides agricultural and horticultural products, including mineral-based absorbent products that serve as carriers for biological and chemical active ingredients, drying agents, and growing media under the Agsorb, Verge, and Flo-Fre brand names. It also offers animal health and nutrition products for the livestock industry; and adsorbent products for bleaching, purification, and filtration applications. In addition, it provides cat litter products under the Cat's Pride and Jonny Cat brands, including scoopable litters, non-clumping litters, probiotic crystal litters, cat litter accessories, and antibacterial clumping litter products; crystal cat litter products under the Ultra Pet brand; animal health and nutrition products under the Amlan brand; industrial and automotive sorbent products under the Oil-Dri brand; sports field products under the Pro's Choice brand; fluids purification products under the Pure-Flo brand; renewable diesel pretreatment adsorbents under the Metal-X and Metal-Z brands; agricultural products under the Agsorb brand; and lawn and garden products under the Verge brand. Its customers include mass merchandisers, farm and fleet channel, drugstore chains, pet specialty retail outlets, dollar stores, retail grocery stores, distributors of industrial cleanup and automotive products, environmental service companies, and sports field product and sports turf material users; processors and refiners of edible oils, petroleum-based oils, and biodiesel fuel; manufacturers of animal feed and agricultural chemicals; distributors of animal health and nutrition products; and marketers of consumer products. The company was founded in 1941 and is based in Chicago, Illinois.
